summary: Iteration 8 features (reminder-call voice response, daily credit quota enforce+display, one-click meeting invite link) fully verified. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass against the live preview URL. Frontend: Team page quota UI, invite-link modal button, Join page (logged-in and guest/register) all work end-to-end.

integration_issues.issue: Right after /invites/{token}/register succeeds and user is routed to /chat/<cid>, the Chat sidebar briefly shows 'Belum ada percakapan' even though GET /api/conversations for the new user DOES include the meeting (verified in backend test). Likely a one-time refresh race — the conversation list is fetched before refreshUser completes. Minor UX polish; the user is on the correct chat URL.

action_items: (Minor) After JoinMeeting registerJoin() redirects to /chat/<cid>, trigger a conversation-list refresh on Chat page so the newly-joined meeting shows up in the sidebar without manual reload.
critical_code_review_comments: reminders.py: respond(accept) now generates an LLM 'opening' message, persists it as the assistant's first message in a private conversation keyed by (user_id, persona_id). If the user already had a prior private chat with that persona the spoken reminder is prepended as a new message — intentional, correct contract.
chat.py invite_info: filter uses {'id': {'$exists': True}, 'invite_token': token}. The id-exists clause is redundant with the invite_token predicate; harmless but can be simplified.
chat.py invite_register: new user gets credits:0 and uses shared wallet via owner_id — consistent with admin.create_workspace_user. Good.

llm.py user_today_usage: UTC-day lexicographic prefix compare on ISO strings works but is fragile if created_at ever gets a different timezone/format. Consider storing a yyyy-mm-dd 'day' field or using proper date range filter.
llm.py quota_exceeded: admins bypass quota (role==admin) — correct per spec. Regular user quota_limit=0 means unlimited — matches Team.jsx placeholder '0 = ∞'.
chat.py send_message: 402 error message is in Indonesian 'Kuota kredit harian Anda habis ({used}/{limit})' — matches spec.
chat.py create_invite_link: idempotent (reuses existing invite_token). Confirmed via test.
JoinMeeting.jsx: registerJoin sets token and calls refreshUser but does not force a re-fetch of /api/conversations. Pair with action item above.

success_rate.frontend: 100% core flows (1 minor sidebar refresh issue)

test_credentials: Admin demo@aivora.ai / demo123456; Regular budi@aivora.ai / budi123456; new invite-registered users created at runtime (TEST_invite_*@aivora.ai, TEST_fe_*@aivora.ai) and cleaned up.
seed_data_creation: Per test module: fresh reminder (title=TEST_rapat_pagi/TEST_notes/TEST_decline) created and deleted; fresh meeting (TEST_invite_meeting, TEST_fe_invite) created and left in DB; invite-registered users deleted via /api/admin/users/{id} where possible.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_quota_invite_reminder.py covers all three new iteration-8 features end-to-end against the public preview URL. Note that /api/personas on this workspace has one legacy persona with name=''; filter out before using. Email on register is lowercased by backend. Reminder respond(accept) requires a persona attached to return 'persona' + 'conversation' keys; without persona only 'message' is returned. The 402 quota error raises before SSE stream begins (synchronous HTTPException, not an SSE event). Admins are never quota-blocked.
rca of the issue: No new bugs. The only observed UX nit (sidebar not auto-refreshing right after guest-join) is cosmetic and does not block the core flow — user is routed to /chat/<cid> correctly and backend GET /api/conversations returns the meeting.
